lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Enzo typed it out in a panic without formatting.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: When the system crashed, the metadata got stripped.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I just learned how to bold text yesterday!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'm an encoder, not an editor!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: But if I mess up… then The Paragon dies.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: And the whistleblower's story dies with it.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I have to visit the Janitor in the canteen to get this story straight.
